source.interpretation: The three-lateen interpretation is supported cautiously by a later community catalogue retaining Caravel1 as Caravela Latina. This is not proof of unchanged retail rig geometry. Castle layout and dimensions are authored. A later New Horizons catalogue distinguishes Caravel1 (lateen) from Caravel2 (square-rigged). This deliverable chooses one authored lateen family reconstruction in two paint palettes; it does not claim to reproduce both original rig variants.
